artworks.title: Christ on the Cross with Angels
artworks.medium: woodcut, faintly touched in red
artworks.description: The image shows several figures surrounding a crucifixion. The main figure is on a wooden cross with outstretched arms and crossed feet, nailed in place. He has a bearded face with closed eyes, wears a crown of thorns, and is clad in a cloth around the waist. There are angels around the cross holding chalices to collect blood. To the left, a woman stands with hands clasped, wearing a robe and a halo. To the right, a man with long hair and a beard stands with hands together, also wearing a robe and halo. Below, skeletal remains are scattered on the ground.

artworks.title: The Pietà
artworks.medium: woodcut in brown, hand-colored in yellow ochre, green, rose, and gold
artworks.description: The image shows two figures in a traditional Christian iconographic style. One figure is lying on the lap of the other, who is seated. The lying figure has a solemn expression, a beard, and wears a crown of thorns. The seated figure has clasped hands over their chest, a serene expression, and possibly a halo or hood. Both figures are fully clothed. The background includes a large cross with an inscription at the top, set in a simple landscape with green coloration. The image is framed with a simple red border.

artworks.title: Pietà with Saint John
artworks.medium: woodcut, hand-colored in blue, red, green, ochre, orange, and gold; with additions in pen and ink
artworks.description: The image shows three figures with their full body depicted. The central figure is a male with visible rib bones, a beard, and long hair, dressed in a yellow cloth. Two other figures stand on either side of him; one is a woman in a blue robe with a hood, and the other is a female in an orange robe. Both have halos around their heads and light-colored hair flowing past their shoulders, with hands in gestures of prayer or mourning. The background shows a landscape with green grass, hills, buildings, and a large wooden cross with the letters "INRI" at the top. The sky has a blend of colors.

artworks.title: Pietà with Saint John
artworks.medium: woodcut in brown, hand-colored in red, green, tan, yellow, and black
artworks.description: This is a painting of three figures centered around a cross and a ladder, with a tree in the background. The painting depicts a scene with three figures in close proximity. One figure in a red robe is holding a vessel and seems to be engaged in an action or gesture towards the central figure, who is lying on a cloth with visible markings on the body. This central figure has a halo and wears a crown of thorns. Another figure, dressed in earth-toned robes, is kneeling with hands clasped in a gesture resembling prayer, also with a halo depicted around the head. The backdrop shows a large wooden cross, partially obscured by a tall ladder, with a tree situated to the side.

artworks.title: Christ Sitting on His Tomb with One Angel
artworks.medium: woodcut, hand-colored in carmine red and green
artworks.description: The image shows two full-body figures. The central figure is seated on a rectangular structure with legs bent, feet on green ground. This figure has long hair, a beard, a green crown, a halo, and is bare-chested. They are draped with a cloth. Behind them, a person in a brown robe with wings holds part of the cloth. The background has a patterned frame.

artworks.title: Christ in the Tomb with Two Angels
artworks.medium: woodcut, hand-colored in red, orange-yellow, blue-green, green, and gold
artworks.description: The image shows three figures mainly displaying their upper bodies. The central figure is seated, leaning against the support of two other figures on either side. The central person has long hair, a beard, closed eyes, wears a crown of thorns, and shows red marks on his body. His torso is bare with fabric around his waist. On the left and right are two angelic figures with long hair, big colorful wings, and one in a robe with patterns. The angel on the right has a hand raised. The background features architectural elements like pointed arches and stained-glass windows.

artworks.title: Christ between Maria and John
artworks.medium: woodcut
artworks.description: The image is a woodcut depicting three individuals from the chest up. In the center is Jesus with a crown of thorns and a halo, arms crossed over their bare chest. On the left is Mary wearing a headscarf and a robe, with clasped hands and a halo. On the right is another figure with shoulder-length curly hair, a halo, and a robe, likely John. The background features a wooden cross with a small plaque. The artwork is monochromatic with detailed linework.

artworks.title: Madonna as a Protectress
artworks.medium: woodcut, hand-colored in rose carmine, green, and yellow
artworks.description: This print depicts a woman standing upright with her arms outstretched. She has pale orange skin, long, wavy, pale-yellow hair, and she wears a crown on her head, accentuated by a large circular halo behind her. Her face is turned to the left, and has simple features, including large eyes, a straight nose, and a thin mouth. She is dressed in a long robe of pinkish red with a red-orange cloak draped over her extended arms. Several smaller, nude people kneel under her arms, looking up at her with clasped hands. Two additional people wearing robes are visible in the upper corners of the print, their hands also clasped. The person on the left appears to have green wings. The background is plain, off-white paper, and the ground at the bottom is green.

artworks.title: Madonna as Protectress
artworks.medium: woodcut in brown, hand-colored in blue, red brown, yellow, gold, and red
artworks.description: The image shows a woman with long blonde hair and light skin, wearing a brown gown and blue mantle. Her arms are slightly extended and she has a serene expression. A dark halo-like circle frames her head. Surrounding her are smaller figures with only their heads and shoulders visible under her mantle. The background is textured with horizontal blue lines, enclosed by a red border.

artworks.title: Madonna in a Wreath of Roses
artworks.medium: woodcut, hand-colored in red lake, green, and gray-yellow
artworks.dimensions: diameter (trimmed within plate mark): 17.8 cm (7 in.)
artworks.description: This is a painting of a religious scene with a floral border. The central figure is in the foreground wearing a red and green robe and a halo. Surrounding this figure are angelic beings with large wings and red and green garments. Above the scene, another figure reclines on a cloud holding two scepters. The background features a mountainous landscape to the left and a distant castle or town to the right. The entire composition is enclosed by a border of roses. The image uses a palette of earthy tones with touches of red and green. This style resembles a medieval illumination or woodcut, possibly inspired by Northern European artists like Albrecht Dürer.

artworks.title: Madonna in a Rosary with Saints
artworks.medium: woodcut, hand-colored in red, ochre, green, gray, and tan
artworks.description: This is a painting of a religious scene with various figures, surrounded by a wreath of flowers. The painting depicts a wreath of flowers encircling a central group, with figures holding objects or wearing crowns. Each figure is adorned with a halo. Above and below the central circle are additional figures on clouds, holding items like a crucifix and a palm. The scene includes details such as a face or mask at the bottom center. The composition is symmetrical, with balanced elements surrounding the central group.

artworks.title: The Assumption of the Virgin
artworks.medium: woodcut
artworks.description: The image is a line drawing showing a central figure standing with hands clasped in front, surrounded by radiating lines. This figure wears a crown and long robes, and has long flowing hair. Two smaller figures are shown kneeling on either side, appearing to be angels with wings. The background is plain.

artworks.title: Madonna and Child
artworks.medium: hand-colored woodcut
artworks.description: The image depicts the upper half of two figures in a close embrace. The figure on the left is a child with short hair, a round face, and a halo. The other figure is a woman with long hair, a halo, and a crown. The woman has a serene expression and is wearing a robe with star patterns. Both figures are surrounded by a circular design with green and red colors in the background. At the bottom, there is text that reads "MARIA DEL CARMELI." The background is a light-colored surface.

artworks.title: Madonna and Child in a Glory
artworks.medium: woodcut in brown, hand-colored in red lake, blue, yellow, green, gold, and orange; retouched with pen and ink
artworks.description: The image depicts two figures' upper bodies. The figure on the left stands upright and holds a smaller figure. The larger figure has long wavy hair, a serene expression, and delicate facial features indicated by minimalist lines. They wear a red robe with a blue garment visible underneath, and a large, ornate crown. The smaller figure held also wears a similar crown and sits facing the larger figure. The background shows a radiant pattern resembling rays of light, set against a textured blue and green backdrop with a simple border.

artworks.title: Madonna and Child in a Glory Standing on a Crescent Moon
artworks.medium: woodcut in gray-black, hand-colored in red lake, yellow, green, and brown
artworks.description: The image shows a woman holding a small child against her chest. She is standing on a crescent moon, wearing a long red robe. The woman has long flowing hair, a serene expression, and a large crown on her head with a halo surrounding it. The child is unclothed with curly hair, looking up at the woman. The background features golden rays, and there are depictions of foliage at their feet on a light yellow backdrop.

artworks.title: Madonna and Child in a Glory with an Indulgence and a Prayer
artworks.medium: woodcut in brown, hand-colored in red lake, yellow, and green
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to image): 16.5 x 12.6 cm (6 1/2 x 4 15/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a medieval manuscript page with a partial depiction of figures on the left side. The scene captures the upper bodies of two individuals within a rectangular panel. One figure appears to be an adult holding a child in their arms. The adult has long hair and wears a crown or halo, while the child also has a halo and is wrapped in a garment. Both figures wear red and gold clothing. The background features a golden texture. Flanking the figures on the right is a passage of text in an ornate typeface.

artworks.title: Madonna and Child in a Glory Standing on a Crescent Moon
artworks.medium: woodcut, hand-colored in rose, green, yellow
artworks.description: The image shows two figures, a woman holding a child. The woman stands with the child in her arms. She has long, flowing hair and wears a crown. The woman is dressed in flowing garments, and the child also wears a garment. Both figures are surrounded by a radiating pattern. In the background, there are abstract shapes and patterns framing the figures, with a hint of green foliage at the bottom.

artworks.title: Madonna and Child in a Glory Standing on a Crescent Moon
artworks.medium: woodcut, hand-colored in peach, blue, gray, green, and gold on vellum
artworks.description: The image shows a woman holding a child. Both figures have halos around their heads. The woman has long, wavy hair and wears flowing garments in earthy tones and hints of blue and pink. Radiating lines around them suggest light. The child has defined facial features. They stand on a green patch with a crescent moon or similar object beneath them. The background is a textured surface bordered by a gold outline.

artworks.title: Madonna in a Closed Garden
artworks.medium: woodcut in brown, hand-colored in red lake, yellow, green, gray, and tan
artworks.description: The image features two adults and one child in various poses. The central figure is seated with long, light-colored hair and wearing a red robe. A child with curly hair and a halo is on the left, holding a flower. On the sides are two angels, one standing with wings and a scroll, and the other sitting or kneeling with folded hands. The background shows floral patterns, a garden scene, and a woven basket-like element.

artworks.title: Madonna and Child Seated on a Grassy Bank with Angels
artworks.medium: woodcut in dark brown, hand-colored in light red lake, dark blue, green, brown, gold, and orange with tarnished silver leaf on laid paper
artworks.description: The image displays a full view of a seated woman's body, who is holding a small child in her lap. The woman is upright, facing forward, with long, wavy hair flowing down past her shoulders. The child also faces forward and has curly hair. Both individuals wear crowns with halos depicted around their heads, and two winged figures above and on either side. The woman is dressed in a flowing robe in shades of orange and beige, with intricate folds and patterns. They are surrounded by lush greenery, with a deep blue background and an ornate border in earthy tones and hints of red.

artworks.title: Madonna with the Rosary
artworks.medium: woodcut, hand-colored in red lake, green, brown, yellow, tan, gray, rose, and black
artworks.dimensions:
image: 37.2 x 24.8 cm (14 5/8 x 9 3/4 in.)
sheet (external frame dimensions): 37.8 x 25.6 cm (14 7/8 x 10 1/16 in.)
artworks.description: This is a painting of a central religious figure surrounded by various biblical scenes and ornate decorations. The central figure is seated in a detailed environment filled with other religious figures, all adorned with symbolic attire. The surrounding elements depict different biblical narratives in circular frames, accentuated by floral motifs and heraldic elements. Below is a block of historical text with the date '1485'. The style is indicative of late medieval religious art and resembles that of an anonymous medieval manuscript illustrator.

artworks.title: The Madonna and Child in a Rosary
artworks.medium: woodcut, hand-colored in brown, red, and green
artworks.description: The image displays a woman standing on a crescent moon, holding a child in her left arm. The woman has a calm expression, wears a crown, and has straight hair falling from under the crown. She is clothed in a long red robe with hints of an undergarment showing. The child is wrapped in a cloth and seated facing slightly forward. The scene is framed by emanating rays and a floral border, with the woman's head surrounded by a halo and almond-shaped elements. The background features decorative patterns with floral motifs and scrolls.

artworks.title: The Madonna and Child in a Rosary
artworks.medium: woodcut, hand-colored in light purple, rose carmine, gray on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a full-body illustration of a person holding a child, both facing slightly to one side. The adult figure has long hair, a crown, and a serene expression. They are wearing draped garments, giving a regal look. A radiant pattern surrounds them, resembling a sunburst or halo, with the figures standing on a crescent shape. The border features intricate floral and leaf patterns. The background is textured paper with decorative elements, and there are ornamental symbols on the border. A ribbon or banner at the bottom displays unreadable text.

artworks.title: Madonna and Child in a Rosary
artworks.medium: woodcut, hand-colored in red lake, yelllow, black,green, brown, and rose on laid paper
artworks.description: This print depicts a woman holding a child. The woman has simple facial features, pale skin, and long, wavy, yellow hair. She is dressed in a red robe over a gray garment, and there is a yellow crown on her head surrounded by a yellow halo. The child in her arms also has pale skin and short curly hair surrounded by a yellow halo, and they are unclothed. The woman is surrounded by rays of yellow light that emanate from her against a black background. Below the bottom of her dress, there seems to be a human face with pale skin that points downward, a frown on its face. Surrounding the woman is a circular border of flowers in white, red, and yellow, with green leaves between them. In the four corners of the print are different creatures holding scrolls, including an angel in the top left, a bird in the top right, a bull in the bottom right, and a lion in the bottom left. The bottom two animals have red wings, and all three have yellow halos. The angel has green wings.
